about.title: About
about.author: By {name}
about.tagline: Free and open dive logbook, compatible with Subsurface logbooks.
releaseNotes: First test version.
Logbook synced with the Subsurface cloud, or kept on this device only.
Dive pages with the profile, trips and sites on the map.
Download from the dive computer over Bluetooth (Android).
Statistics, planner and gas tools.
Sites: map, site page, dives without a site, sites without coordinates and duplicate clean-up.
Delete a dive from its menu, with “Undo” for 10 seconds.
Swipe left or right to go from one section of the menu to the next.
Privacy policy and “Question / report a problem” in About.
Gas blender: nitrox by default, the last mode chosen is remembered.
Syncing: the current stage and a progress bar in the menu.
“Sync now”: the list and the menu stay in place, the button shows the progress and a message confirms the end or reports the error.
Planner: the plan data are edited in place, its settings have their own screen, with a single ascent rate.
Planner: the decompression ceiling in red on the planned profile.
In cubic feet, the SAC is shown with two decimals.
Planner: round defaults in the chosen units (45 ft, 3,000 psi, 60 ft/min…), and gas used in the chosen volume unit.
A “Stop download” button under the progress of a download from the dive computer.
Newly downloaded dives are numbered in sequence, even when the download also reads older dives again.
Planner: the SAC is chosen from a menu, in steps of 0.5 L/min or 0.01 cu ft/min.
Edit the dive: every field Subsurface desktop edits, cylinders and weights included; choosing a weight location fills in the last weight used for it.
The progress bar of a download from the dive computer moves steadily while each dive is transferred.
Dive profile: graduated depth and time axes, and a water temperature curve that can be shown or hidden.
Edit the dive: the number is no longer changed there (it will go through “Renumber the dive”); duration and max. depth are shown, measured by the dive computer.
Edit the dive: site and trip are typed or chosen from the filtered list; a new name creates the site or the trip. The suit now comes before the dive mode.
Dive detail, ⋮ menu: “Renumber the dive”; the dives it affects shift so that numbers stay unique and without gaps.
Dive detail, ⋮ menu: “Share” a one-page PDF sheet or a short summary with the profile image.
Settings, Language and formats: “Paper size” of the PDF sheet (from the region, US Letter or A4).
